_doc: Quebec statutory holidays (Loi sur les normes du travail) falling on a weekday. Read by tools/adapt_feries.js (R41, model v11). PLQ closure days are NOT here: Franck adds them to his Outlook calendar as events whose subject starts with 'Fermeture' or 'Férié' (read by the same adapter). Good Friday kept, Easter Monday not (employer's choice; add it to the calendar if the office closes).
source: Loi sur les normes du travail du Québec, art. 60 · Loi sur la fête nationale
